module: Internal module that assembles the ImGui API: creates the table M with the field ctx (global ImGui context) then injects the generated functions from imgui_luaintf.lua and the custom additions from imgui_custom_luaintf.lua. The file states not to use it directly (use ui_imgui) and that it must stay in sync with imgui_api.h on the C++ side.
notes: Both requires use the path '/common/extensions/ui/...' and each module returns a function that receives M.
ctx is nil until ui_imgui sets it (onImGuiReady / onExtensionLoaded).

ctx.desc: Global Lua ImGui context; nil at creation, set by ui_imgui.
